bio: This lead is now definitively excluded. John's 3rd great-grandfather Henry J. Meier was alive in the 1950 census at 16 Barney St, Wilkes-Barre, aged 83 ([R4-S1]), and died at Wilkes-Barre on 20 Dec 1950 (PA death index 1950, file 104173) ([R4-S2]). The Henry Meier who died at Huntington, Long Island, in 1931 is someone else.
